reference: Same genuine Microsoft3.6 retail x86/x64 DLLs and static Refresh bridge as PROVENANCE.json; native Wine/null output only
sdk: Untouched own SDK banks, same authoring tool and original input WAVs as PROVENANCE.json

modes.before: Prepare P before L; L plays; prepare/play I; then P.Play
modes.after: L plays; prepare P; prepare/play I; then P.Play
modes.destroyed: Prepare P before L; L plays; destroy P; prepare/play I
modes.paused: L plays; Pause L; prepare/play I; after settling Resume L
modes.stopping: L plays; StopAsAuthored L; settle20ms; prepare/play I

observations.oldest_controls: none/after/destroyed settle LStopped/IPlaying/count1; before leaves PPrepared/LPlaying/IPlaying/count2
observations.prepared_handle_continuation: P.Play succeeds after before/after: before leaves P/I playing/count2, after leaves P playing/count1
observations.evicted_state: At20ms, L state8 or72 if paused; I state8; both variables and bank count2. After settling, L state32 and count1 unless leading P absorbs the replacement
observations.paused_victim: Paused bit persists during the fade; victim retires without Resume; later Resume does not resurrect it
observations.fail: cue FAIL rejects I.Play; category FAIL rejects I.Prepare with no handle; already-prepared P.Play also rejects when the category is full
observations.authored_tail: After requested20ms settling Lstate16 or32/count0; I prepares and plays successfully even with FAIL maximum1, both scopes
observations.failed_old_handle_cache: Rejected older P retains its previously published value1; failure does not clear cache

limits: No native Windows or managed wrapper execution
No PCM output or native fade gain/shape measurement; gain equations and exact deterministic deadlines use FAudio source
No native multiple-overflow overlap timing qualification; no test of other cue shapes/instance modes
Native snapshots use DoWork/Sleep1 and coarse GetTickCount64 settling; requested20ms is not an upper wall-time bound, and state16/32 can differ; no asynchronous publication instant guarantee

refresh_admission_bridge.Cue.Play: Native bridge passes HRESULT unchanged (IL_0032-003b); public Cue.Play specially ignores8ac70008 at IL_000c-0012, then sets played at IL_001a-001c
refresh_admission_bridge.SoundBank.GetCue: Public IL_0035-005d maps80070057 to the cue-name error; all other failures go through ThrowExceptionFromErrorCode at IL_005e-005f
refresh_admission_bridge.note: Static Refresh IL, not managed-wrapper execution; GetCue exception mapping will be exercised in the next admission task
